text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The seasons cycle on.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And so, City.
Back then, my Trainer said...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! Come here for a sec!
There's something I want you to see!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa... what's up?
You're really rushing me.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes B & C
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that who I think it is out on the track...?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Those girls are running in the debut selection race soon!
They're seriously fired up!
They're dead set on finding a Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"My debut race has been decided too!
...So, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, teach me how to run!!
I wanna win just like you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, obviously!
Like I wouldn't tell ya!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan achieved fantastic results
over these past three years.
Thanks to that, next year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock... *slide*)

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Thank you for all your hard work this year too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember correctly, she's Tosen Jordan's homeroom teacher.
I've consulted with her many times whenever makeup classes or retests came up."
choice_data_list: Great work out there too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No, not compared to you, Trainer.
So... is Jordan planning to run in races next year too?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Is that so... That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Then even if we are apart,
I'll be able to watch you shine on TV.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let 'er rip, let 'er rip, weeeey!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Waaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... The back is falling behind!
Palmer's super dangerous, so
you won't be able to catch her at this rate-!
choice_data_list: Are you teaching your friend how to run?
Are you teaching your friend how to run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Everyone's gonna run in the selection trials and races soon!
So I asked Palmer and City to lend a hand, and...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer. That's my homeroom teacher
standing behind you. Hilarious.
When did you two become buddies?
choice_data_list: Every time you have to take supplementary lessons...
Every time you have to take supplementary lessons, you see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~... Ahaha.
Well, thank you for that~
choice_data_list: Anyway, there's something I want to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"You want to show everyone the way I run?
Why?"
choice_data_list: I heard Trainer is leaving the academy.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I'm getting married soon.
So I'm heading back to my hometown with my husband.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanted to burn Jordan-san's growth into my memory—as the biggest problem child in our class.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, calling someone a problem child right to their face~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, fine. I don't mind running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan lined up on the track
alongside her friends.

text_block_list.name: Jordan and the Others
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan and the pack dash out together.
Taking the lead is Mejiro Palmer,
with Daitaku Helios right on her heels.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan was... around the middle of the pack.
Biding her time alongside Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Urooooohhhhhh-aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...For some reason, Gold Ship was right behind.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though she slept through class no matter how many times I warned her,
she sure looks like she's having fun running."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, there was that time I barged into your room right after New Year's, wasn't there, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"She was quite a handful, and I was worried about her.
That is, until... you became her Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I ain't gonna looooose!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I feel like her atmosphere has changed.
No, perhaps it's more that she's become her true self.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's why... thank you very much,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I'm so exhaausted~...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Jordan-san.
Keep giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You too, Teach.
Thanks for everything up till now.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... So Teacher's really leaving, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Y'know, I helped a pal with her practice today.
Said she was running in the Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
One year, three years...
Doesn't it all just fly by in a flash?
I mean, I totally thought tomorrow would just be another today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So many things are changing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I want to win more and more.
Not just regular races, but awesome ones,
at the GⅠ level.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm gonna get even bigger!
So... until the day we have to say goodbye, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Until then, stay as my Trainer, okay?
choice_data_list: I'm going to make you even bigger and better.
I'm going to make you even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Welp, see ya.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Looking forward to working with you going forward~!
